zeroSpendBasis: No model/API invocation was attempted; local version/help and git/network evidence operations only. This is not a claim that future failed calls cost zero.
stopRule: Record all calls, including failed/retried/cached/preparatory calls. Before each next call compare parent-qualified cost bounds and remaining aggregate allowance; stop and report if approaching/exceeding US$2 or consumption is unknown. No automatic retry/fallback/model escalation.
